# 🎄 Christmas.nvim

A simple festive Neovim colorscheme to accompany you during Advent of Code.

## Installation

**Lazy:**

```lua
{
    "chaserensberger/christmas.nvim",
    name = "christmas",
    lazy = false,
}
```

## Usage

```lua
vim.cmd("colorscheme christmas")
```
